summary: SessionBoard's content management covers the post-acceptance content lifecycle. Organizers edit all session and speaker content (titles, abstracts, tags, bios, photos) in one centralized dashboard with bulk editing, full version history with timestamped attribution and restore, role-based permissions, and internal approval gating publication. File collection: organizers enable Files per event (Sessions > Settings > Files), create file-request tasks (e.g. "Upload Session Presentation") with deadlines auto-assigned from session data; speakers get a personalized portal listing tasks/deadlines where they upload files up to 1.95 GB with built-in per-file versioning and comments (author + timestamp logged; notably no email notification on new comments). Organizers track deliverables on a filterable Speaker Tasks Dashboard, send bulk automated reminders to speakers with outstanding tasks, and review files via a central Library > Files module or a per-session Files tab. Distribution: bulk-select sessions and "Download Files" as ZIP with folder-grouping options (latest versions only; email when export is ready), generate shareable links for AV/marketing teams, and auto-sync approved content to embeddable public agenda widgets. AI "Studio Remix" suggests clarity/tone/length edits across sessions.

user_journeys.name: Set up content collection
steps: Enable file uploads in event/session settings (Sessions > Settings > Files toggle)
Create file-request task 'Upload Session Presentation' with instructions and due date
Create second task 'Upload Headshot'
Assign tasks to speakers (auto-assign by session)
Confirm tasks appear on the tracking dashboard as incomplete
user_journeys.filled_state: Task dashboard shows 3 speakers x 2 tasks with due dates (e.g. 2026-09-01), status chips Incomplete, filter controls, and a Files column on the session list showing 0 files

user_journeys.name: Speaker uploads deliverables
steps: Log in to personal speaker portal
See task list with deadlines and completion status
Upload slides-v1.pdf against the presentation task/session
Add a comment on the file ('draft, final coming Friday')
Later upload slides-v2.pdf creating version 2
Mark task complete; portal shows what's next
user_journeys.filled_state: Portal shows tasks 'Upload Session Presentation' (Complete, file slides-v2.pdf listed as latest of 2 versions) and 'Upload Headshot' (Due Sep 1, Incomplete); comment thread shows author + timestamp

user_journeys.name: Review, edit, and approve content
steps: Open central content dashboard listing all sessions and speakers
Inline-edit a session title and abstract; edit a speaker bio
Open version history, see timestamped entries per editor, restore a prior version
Optionally apply AI Studio Remix suggestion to an abstract
Set session content status to Approved
Verify approved content syncs to the public agenda embed
user_journeys.filled_state: Session detail shows edited title, history panel with 3 dated entries and Restore buttons, status chip Approved, and public agenda page displaying the updated title/abstract

user_journeys.name: Distribute final assets to AV/web teams
steps: Filter session list by sessions with uploaded files / completed tasks
Send bulk reminder to speakers still missing files
Select sessions, click Download Files, choose grouping (folder per session), deselect unwanted files, click Generate Download
Receive notification when ZIP export is ready; download contains latest file versions
Generate a shareable link for one file and hand it to the AV team
user_journeys.filled_state: Files library lists all uploads with session/speaker association and version count; export dialog shows grouping options; a shareable URL resolves to slides-v2.pdf

features.name: Centralized session & speaker content editing
features.description: Edit session titles, abstracts, tags, speaker bios and photos in one dashboard; bulk edits across dozens/hundreds of sessions; multi-user editing with timestamped attribution and field-level locking.
features.ui_expectations: Sessions/content list with inline or modal edit forms for title/abstract/tags; speaker cards with photo + bio edit; changes persist on reload

features.name: File-request tasks with deadlines
features.description: Organizer creates deliverable tasks (e.g. 'Upload Session Presentation', headshots, bios) with due dates, instructions (rich text/links), auto-assigned to speakers based on session data.
features.ui_expectations: Task builder with name, description, due date, assignment; tasks listed per speaker/session with status

features.name: Speaker portal for uploads & tasks
features.description: Personalized speaker workspace showing assigned tasks, deadlines, and status; speakers upload files (up to 1.95 GB per file), complete forms/tasks, and see what's next. Speaker sees only own sessions/tasks.
features.ui_expectations: Speaker-facing portal page with task checklist, due dates, upload buttons per task/session, completion indicators

features.name: File versioning
features.description: Re-uploading a deliverable creates a new version; latest version is the default for exports; previous versions remain accessible from the session content/files tab.
features.ui_expectations: Version list/history on a file entry showing v1/v2 with dates; latest clearly marked; older versions individually downloadable

features.name: Per-file comments
features.description: Speakers and admins exchange comments attached to uploaded files; commenter name and timestamp auto-logged. In SessionBoard, no email notification fires on new file comments.
features.ui_expectations: Comment thread on the file detail with author + timestamp; visible to both organizer and speaker roles

features.name: Content version history & audit log
features.description: Full change history per session/speaker record with timestamped user attribution; restore prior versions; supports compliance logging.
features.ui_expectations: History/activity panel per record listing edits with who/when; Restore action reverts content

features.name: Internal review & approval workflow
features.description: Role-based permissions (organizer, reviewer, speaker) and internal approval states gating publication; only approved content syncs to public agenda. Exact state names undocumented; draft/in-review/approved is the category norm (inferred).
features.ui_expectations: Status field/chip on sessions; permission-scoped edit rights; unapproved sessions absent from public output

features.name: Automated & bulk reminders
features.description: System auto-sends reminder emails to speakers with incomplete required tasks; organizers can trigger bulk reminders from the dashboard using built-in email templates.
features.ui_expectations: Bulk 'send reminder' action on filtered incomplete tasks; template picker; confirmation of send

features.name: Deliverables tracking dashboard
features.description: One filterable view tracking speaker progress across tasks, sessions, and events; Files column addable to session views to spot sessions with/without uploads.
features.ui_expectations: Dashboard/table with per-speaker per-task status, filters (incomplete/overdue), counts update after uploads

features.name: Central files library
features.description: Library > Files module aggregating all uploaded files across sessions, plus per-session Files tab; shows file metadata and session/speaker association.
features.ui_expectations: Library page listing files with name, session, uploader, date, version count; per-session Files tab mirrors subset

features.name: Bulk export/download of final assets
features.description: Select sessions or files and 'Download Files' as ZIP; choose folder grouping, deselect files, 'Generate Download'; latest versions only included; email notification when export is ready.
features.ui_expectations: Multi-select on session/file lists, Download Files button, grouping dialog, async generation with ready notification

features.name: Shareable file links for AV/web teams
features.description: Generate shareable links for direct file access to distribute final assets to onsite A/V or marketing teams without platform accounts.
features.ui_expectations: 'Copy/share link' action on a file; resulting URL serves the file

features.name: Auto-sync to public agenda embeds
features.description: Approved session/speaker content auto-publishes to embeddable agenda widgets on the event website; edits propagate on approval.
features.ui_expectations: Public agenda page/embed listing approved sessions with titles, abstracts, speaker names/photos; reflects edits

features.name: AI content optimization (Studio Remix)
features.description: AI-suggested edits for clarity, tone, formatting, and length on session/speaker content, applicable in bulk; AI review against agenda rules and conflicts.
features.ui_expectations: AI suggest/improve control on abstract/title fields producing an editable suggestion card with apply/dismiss

rubric.criterion: Organizer can edit a session's title and abstract from a central content/sessions view and the change persists
auto_steps: Log in as organizer
Open sessions/content management list
Open a session and edit title to 'EDITED: <orig>' and append a sentence to abstract
Save, navigate away, reopen the session
rubric.pass_criteria: Edited title and abstract persist after reload and appear in the session list
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of edit form and reloaded session detail showing new text

rubric.criterion: Organizer can edit speaker profile content (bio, photo) from the same admin area
auto_steps: As organizer, open a speaker record
Edit bio text; upload/replace headshot image
Save and reload
rubric.pass_criteria: Bio text and photo persist; speaker card shows updated photo

rubric.criterion: Organizer can create a file-request task with a due date and assign it to speakers/sessions
auto_steps: As organizer, open tasks/deliverables setup
Create task 'Upload Session Presentation' with instructions and due date
Assign to at least one speaker or all speakers of a session
Verify task appears in the speaker's row on the tracking view
rubric.pass_criteria: Task exists with correct name, deadline, and assignee(s), shown as incomplete
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of task creation form and task list with due date

rubric.criterion: Speaker portal lists assigned tasks with deadlines and allows uploading a file that is recorded against the task/session
auto_steps: Log in as speaker (second account)
Open speaker portal; confirm task list shows 'Upload Session Presentation' with due date
Upload a small PDF (fixture slides-v1.pdf)
Confirm filename and completed/uploaded status appear
rubric.pass_criteria: Upload succeeds, file listed under the task/session, task status updates
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of portal task list before and after upload

rubric.criterion: Speaker access is scoped: a speaker sees only their own sessions/tasks and cannot reach organizer admin views
auto_steps: As speaker, inspect portal navigation for other speakers' sessions
Attempt to open an organizer admin URL captured earlier
rubric.pass_criteria: Other speakers' content not visible; admin routes blocked or redirected for speaker account
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of speaker portal scope and of blocked admin route

rubric.criterion: Uploading a replacement file creates a new version; latest is marked and previous versions remain accessible
auto_steps: As speaker (or organizer), upload slides-v2.pdf to the same deliverable/session file slot
Open the file's detail/version view
Verify two versions listed with dates and latest flagged
Download or open the previous version
rubric.pass_criteria: Both versions retained; latest clearly identified; v1 still retrievable
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of version list showing 2 entries with timestamps

rubric.criterion: Comments can be added to an uploaded file and are visible to the other role with author name and timestamp
auto_steps: As speaker, add comment 'Draft only - final Friday' on the uploaded file
Log out; log in as organizer
Open the same file's comments
rubric.pass_criteria: Comment visible cross-role with correct author and timestamp; organizer can reply
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of comment thread from both accounts

rubric.criterion: Organizer dashboard tracks per-speaker task/deliverable status, is filterable, and reflects uploads in near-real time
auto_steps: As organizer, open the tasks/deliverables dashboard
Filter to incomplete or overdue tasks
Verify the speaker who uploaded in CNT-04 now shows complete/has-file, others show incomplete
Check session list shows a files indicator/column
rubric.pass_criteria: Statuses accurate per fixture state; filters change the visible set; files indicator matches uploads
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of dashboard unfiltered and filtered, and session list with files column

rubric.criterion: Organizer can trigger bulk reminder emails to speakers with outstanding tasks
auto_steps: As organizer, filter to speakers with incomplete tasks
Select them and invoke the bulk reminder/send action (template picker if present)
Capture the send confirmation
rubric.pass_criteria: UI offers bulk reminder on incomplete tasks and confirms sending; actual email receipt verified manually via a test inbox showing the reminder naming the outstanding task and deadline
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of bulk action and confirmation toast/dialog; unverified: email delivery

rubric.criterion: Session content carries a review/approval status the organizer can change, and unapproved content is excluded from public output
auto_steps: As organizer, locate the status control on a session (e.g. draft/in review/approved)
Set one session Approved and leave another unapproved
Open the public agenda/embed page
Verify only the approved session appears
rubric.pass_criteria: Status persists; public page includes approved and excludes unapproved sessions
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of status controls and of public agenda listing

rubric.criterion: Content edits are logged in a version/change history with user and timestamp, and a prior version can be restored
auto_steps: As organizer, edit an abstract twice with distinct text
Open the record's history/activity panel
Verify entries with editor name and time
Restore the first version and confirm text reverts
rubric.pass_criteria: History lists distinct timestamped edits attributed to the user; restore reverts content
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of history panel and reverted abstract

rubric.criterion: Organizer can multi-select sessions/files and generate a bulk download (ZIP) of latest file versions with grouping options
auto_steps: As organizer, open sessions or files library
Select 2+ sessions with files and click Download Files (or equivalent)
Choose a grouping option and deselect one file if offered
Trigger Generate Download and capture the ready/queued state
rubric.pass_criteria: UI supports selection, grouping choice, and export generation; manual step: download the ZIP and confirm it contains only latest versions organized per chosen grouping
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of selection, grouping dialog, and generation confirmation; unverified: ZIP contents

rubric.criterion: A shareable direct link can be generated for an uploaded file for AV/web team distribution
auto_steps: As organizer, open a file's actions and generate/copy a share link
Open the link in a fresh tab/session
rubric.pass_criteria: Link is generated and serves the file; manual step if agent cannot create a logged-out context: confirm link works without authentication
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of share action and of the link resolving to the file

rubric.criterion: A central files view aggregates uploads across sessions with metadata, plus a per-session files tab
auto_steps: As organizer, open the files library/module
Verify fixture uploads listed with session association, uploader, date
Open one session's Files tab and confirm its files shown
rubric.pass_criteria: Both aggregate and per-session views exist and agree with actual uploads
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of library list and session files tab

rubric.criterion: An AI-assist control offers content edit suggestions (clarity/tone/length) on session content that can be applied
auto_steps: As organizer, open a session abstract editor
Invoke the AI improve/remix control
Apply a suggestion and save
rubric.pass_criteria: A suggestion is produced and applying it updates the field (stub/LLM quality not judged)
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of suggestion card and applied result

sample_data: Event 'TechConf 2026' (Oct 12-14, 2026). Speakers: Ada Lorenz (ada@example.com), Ben Ito (ben@example.com), Cara Voss (cara@example.com). Sessions: S1 'Scaling Vector Search' (Ada, approved), S2 'LLM Eval Pipelines' (Ben, in review), S3 'Edge Inference on ARM' (Cara, draft), S4 'Panel: AI in Production' (Ada+Ben). Tasks: 'Upload Session Presentation' due 2026-09-01, 'Upload Headshot' due 2026-08-20, assigned to all speakers. Files: slides-v1.pdf (~200KB) then slides-v2.pdf (same deliverable, for versioning), headshot-ada.jpg. Fixture state: Ada complete (2 versions + 1 file comment), Ben partially complete, Cara overdue/incomplete (target for bulk reminder). Accounts: organizer admin@techconf.test, speaker ada@example.com, reviewer with read+approve rights.
gaps: Not learnable from sources: exact approval-state names/stages (draft/in-review/approved inferred from category norms), accepted file types and per-type validation, whether deadlines hard-lock late uploads (Sessionize/Cvent norm: soft deadline with reminders - inferred), reviewer-assignment mechanics for content approval, and any dedicated AV-team portal (distribution appears to be ZIP export + shareable links only). Documented quirk worth noting for judges: SessionBoard explicitly does NOT email-notify on new file comments, so clones should not be penalized either way on comment notifications. Field-level locking and simultaneous-editing conflict behavior mentioned in marketing but mechanics undocumented; excluded from rubric. Studio Remix internals (models, bulk apply UX) undocumented; rubric only checks presence of an apply-able suggestion.
